channel.title: Cobble Updates
channel.description: Signed Full releases of Cobble for macOS.

item.description:
Full Cobble browser for Apple silicon and macOS 26+.
- Video and page full screen works in Chromium tabs. YouTube and other sites open in their own full-screen Space with a brief "Press Esc to exit" banner. Esc, the site's own button or leaving the Space returns the page to its tab. - A crashed Chromium page no longer quits the whole browser.
Includes WebKit, Chromium and signed in-app updates. Uses the pinned public ABI 18 SDK (371054c) and its matching Chromium runtime.
This is an early beta. Real-site full-screen behavior, interrupted download recovery, real-account authentication, clean-Mac installation and installed version-to-version updates remain unqualified.
Download the ZIP, extract Cobble, quit the old app and replace it in Applications. Beta 1 users need one manual install because that version's updater cannot start.

Full Cobble browser for Apple silicon and macOS 26+.
- Right-click menus work on images and links. Download Image and Download Linked File now save the file, and "Open … in New Tab" opens a background tab. Chromium pages now show a right-click menu; Copy Image no longer crashes, and items that need Chrome windows or panels are hidden. - Links pasted with line breaks, such as wrapped URLs copied from a terminal, now open instead of failing with "The address contains control characters." - Back no longer loops on pages that redirect themselves, such as login, consent and tracking pages. - Tab sleeping: when memory is low, Cobble sleeps hidden tabs. Settings → Tabs → "Sleep inactive tabs" can also sleep them on a timer (off by default). Slept WebKit tabs come back with their history and scroll position. - Installed extensions load again after relaunch, and default tracker rules now install on new profiles. - Typing in the address bar, browsing history and the sidebar are faster. - A looping link to another app can no longer lock the window with repeated prompts. - A download whose name is taken during transfer is saved as "name 2" instead of being deleted. - Recovery notices stay until you dismiss them. Restoring a workspace with iCloud sync on no longer deletes items on other devices.
Includes WebKit, Chromium and signed in-app updates. Uses the pinned public ABI 18 SDK (73ea7c5) and its matching Chromium runtime.
This is an early beta. Interrupted download recovery, real-account authentication, clean-Mac installation and installed version-to-version updates remain unqualified.

Full Cobble browser for Apple silicon and macOS 26+.
- Engine choice is now one setting per website: Automatic, WebKit or Chromium. Change it from the site menu in the address bar, the tab's engine menu, or Settings → General → Web Engine, which also holds this Mac's default engine. - Website engine choices now cover subdomains, so a choice for figma.com also applies to www.figma.com. The most specific website choice wins. - Declining the reload when switching engines keeps the website's previous choice. - Private windows keep engine choices on the tab and never save the websites you visit.
